assertion_analysis.fails_when: Move the measurement guard back after plan_review_hold; the recorded pre-repair control expected --measure-only but received the missing-design-review hold, so the refusal match fails.
Publish a queued or held request despite refusing the landed section; the independent live-pointer inventory is nonempty.
Remove pending-seat waiting and the delayed fake launchers overlap up to the pool width instead of the fixed one- or two-seat fixture; serializing every setup also fails the two-seat case.
Drop a submission while waiting or fail to settle its result; the output launch count is less than the requested pool-width-times-two count.
Return a different completion refusal or success instead of suite-delta-refused; the decoded stdout error differs.
Persist no suite refusal explanation, or a different explanation, in the receipt the production command returns.
Drop, alter or add a failure ID while persisting the computed suite delta; the independently opened receipt differs from the fixture failure written by _record_added_failure_arms.
Let a passing measurement bypass the added-failure guard or persist an incorrect delta; the stdout refusal and opened receipt no longer match the two independently required results.

assertion_independence: No newly added assertion is a vacuous self-comparison. free_seats sets fixture occupancy while peak is measured inside concurrently executed fake launches; failure_id is written to synthetic suite arms while receipt IDs are read back through the production completion command. These are input/output checks that fail if the claimed guard or persistence changes. They do not establish execution of the synthetic suite itself, and that is not their stated purpose.
